## Welcome

This website documents my progress in learning R. In particular, I have been working through R for Data Science (2e), written by Hadley Wickham, Mine Çetinkaya-Rundel, and Garrett Grolemund.

The main focus is on developing a solid understanding of the tidyverse and its use in data analysis. In addition, I have included solutions to selected exercises for practice.

This website serves as my personal learning environment and as an accessible, concise reference based on the book—a place where I can quickly look up the most important concepts and tools needed for data science.

## Topics

- Data visualization

- Data transformation

- Importing data

- Programming
